== Summary ==
The Players Committee's errata wording of [[WED-1016 'Techie' Droid]] (“when forfeited”) as printed in Appendix A. Image for [[WED-1016 'Techie' Droid (PC Errata 2020)]].

Source: Players Committee, [https://res.starwarsccg.org/wp/wp-content/uploads/2021/01/AR327.pdf Advanced Rulebook (January 2021)], Appendix A, PDF page 123; rendered at 300 dpi and cropped to the entry.
